name: Aozora Meikyuu
source:
After a failed love confession Aoi Takamatsu dropped out of school and became a shut-in. 3 years have passed since then and Aoi is forced to leave his house for the first time since years. After he got the thing he wanted he looked up to the horizon and saw a nude girl falling from the sky?! His lazy days are about to change...

[From [url=https://yumecreations.itch.io/aozora-meikyuu]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一次失败的告白后，高松葵辍学并成为一名闭门者。三年过去了，葵多年来第一次被迫离开家。当他得到想要的东西后，抬头望向地平线，看到一个裸体女孩从天而降？！他慵懒的日子即将改变……

[来自[url=https://yumecreations.itch.io/aozora-meikyuu]Itch.io[/url]]
